name: currency
title: Workspace currency
description: Watches the cards that state how something IS. When a card's verify:: date passes, it says so — off-app, on a schedule — so a stale fact is caught by a check rather than by an agent repeating it. With no bot token it prints what it would have sent.

config.label: Telegram bot token
config.help: From @BotFather. The same bot as the notify plugin is fine. Leave empty to preview instead of sending.

config.label: Telegram chat id
config.help: Message your bot once, then open https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates to find it.

config.label: Only this basket id
config.help: Optional. Limits the check to one project's claims.

config.label: Stay silent when nothing is stale (yes/no)
config.help: Default yes. Turn it off to get a confirmation that everything is current.
